publication: Local Git checkpoint only. No push, tag, registry publication, deployment or new installed archive. Runtime bindings were generated into isolated qualification directories; no installed runtime binary or demo-host configuration was replaced.

contracts.explicitTargets: Native rich/plain/first-key methods accept a proved explicit text target without publishing it as the actual selection. History retains actual before-UI, including None, pending styles and a caret whose entire block is deleted. Shared lowering compares the complete independent native result and uses the separate semantic history family.
contracts.style: RichGeneralPlainRangePlan owns the admitted fragment, effective formats and native general plan. An actual caret within a target boundary block contributes its pending/effective style; otherwise the logical start's affinity supplies the style. Unrelated pending styles do not leak. Explicit plain deletion retains the native input style; rich-run deletion maps actual pending styles.
contracts.grouping: An explicit first-key target never joins preceding input. Subsequent same-caret/style typing can join under existing rules. An actual same-caret target delegates to ordinary typing. Empty user input proves its target but does not delete it or create history.
contracts.identity: Hosts reserve one never-reused prefix per authored request, including failed/undone work. Native plans determine the floor count; allocate_general_range_paragraphs derives prefix:range:ordinal. Prefix spelling is bounded to90 UTF8 bytes, not proof of durability. Original source checks and shared historical-definition checks still reject ID reuse, including late collisions after preparation.
contracts.requests: Local Wasm adds separate replaceGeneralRangeText/replaceGeneralRangePlainText/replaceGeneralRangeTypingText commands. Shared Wasm adds corresponding guarded namespace-JSON methods, requiring explicit general semantic history; first-key requests also require natural history. Rich runs carry canonical text and literal-array formatsJson strings. Coordinates and clocks remain canonical decimal strings.
contracts.bounds: The closed request envelope remains1MiB, rich input at most1000 runs and64KiB text. Original native transaction, document, journal, causal-state and transport ceilings remain active. Unknown fields, number-valued coordinates/clocks, unadmitted styles, adjacent equal-format runs and malformed namespaces reject. Stale observations reject before request decoding; mutation requires current write policy. No JavaScript AST rewrite or guessed floor count is introduced.
contracts.capabilities: Local and shared owners advertise general-range capability string1. Source facades require exact complete capabilities, use named native methods and never fall back to original dispatch. Shared views declare rangeEditing:general-v1 only in the explicitly enabled mode. A new-mode owner with an incomplete paired runtime rejects before ownership transfer.
contracts.recovery: Shared checkpointJson selects the native general ordinary/natural getter from the observed mode. restoreSharedGeneralEditor requires both explicit recovery factories and the exact capability; it neither sniffs nor downgrades opaque journals. Existing local and shared-general saved record meanings remain unchanged.
contracts.durableBoundary: Existing persistent shared sessions explicitly seal the original range policy. enableGeneralRanges cannot silently switch a live durable owner behind its stored-family identity guard. General-mode root SDK options, storage records, reopening, closure/recovery and React policy wiring remain required; this protective refusal is not their implementation.

actualWasmAndSourceFacades.scope: Actual isolated release Wasm and current source facades in Node. This is not a clean-installed browser, DOM event, clipboard, general durable-session, reconnect or relay V2 acceptance run.

originalCompatibility.scope: The selected-range preview refactor leaves original-mode saved effects byte-identical. Original commands, factories, document grammar, models, peer frames and saved record meanings are not silently widened.

attempts: The first core compile exposed an unreachable public plan type. Exported the named read-only type through rich_content rather than weakening visibility lint. Corrected the test fixture's PropertyMap constructor to the existing default.

The local rich package deliberately has no build:candidate script. Built its declarations with its existing tsconfig, then rechecked the downstream shared types; the initial downstream type failure came from stale generated declarations, not a new protocol fallback.

An SDK test reused one mock implementation for three methods and inspected a mixed call history. Replaced them with independently typed fake methods, supplied the pre-existing natural-history fake capability and reran all107 cases successfully.

Strict lint caught the data router crossing its100-line limit, an extra borrow and unnecessary owned/Result test helpers. Moved only new command routing to the existing outer dispatcher and used borrowed fixtures with explicit error results. No lint suppression or admission limit was added.

The final real-Wasm probe was expanded from12 to14 scenarios to cover deleting the actual before-caret's complete block. Both ordinary and natural cases pass in current and earlier readers. Final release builds and the complete112-future comparison were rerun after the public Rustdoc correction.
